description: Invalid POST /v1/profile/events bodies, received at received_at for a linked binding of binding_platform whose account has a grant in effect: one case per per-event rejection reason of contract §3.5 (reason unknown_event, invalid_props, invalid_envelope, stale, future: the batch is answered 200, offending_event is the index of the rejected event and the other events are stored) and the batch-level refusals (reason batch: the whole batch is answered 422 and nothing is stored). No client ever produces any of these bodies.

cases.description: A name the registry does not hold.
screen.view without its required screen.
A screen outside the screen enum (chat-level screens are never reported).
priority 5 is above the priority type's max (4).
An error code that is free text, not a stable code (error_code pattern).
A boolean prop sent as a string.
An integer prop sent as a numeric string.
An optional prop sent as null: omit it instead.
An id that is not a uuid4; echoed in rejected[].id (a string of at most 64 bytes).
An upper-case uuid4 (ids are lower-case, as Foundation's uuidString is not).
An id that is not a string: rejected[].id is null.
ts with an offset instead of Z.
ts with fractional seconds.
A session_id that is not a uuid4.
seq below 0 (seq is 0..1000000).
seq must strictly increase per session_id within a batch: the third event repeats the second's seq 5 and is rejected; the first two are stored.
props is a list, not an object.
props is always present (it may be {}).
An event-level key outside id, name, ts, session_id, seq, props.
An event that is not a JSON object: rejected[].id is null.

An event of 2049 bytes in its compact JSON serialization (no whitespace, slashes and non-ASCII unescaped), one byte above the 2 KiB limit. The padding is an undeclared prop: the size is checked first, so it is rejected, not trimmed.
effective_ts 7 days and 1 second before receipt (sent_at equals receipt: no skew).
effective_ts 301 seconds after receipt (sent_at equals receipt: no skew).
schema_version other than 1.
No schema_version.
A top-level key outside the envelope.
Device credentials travel as headers on every new route, never in the body.
taxonomy_version is 1..32767.
batch_id is a uuid4.
sent_at is an instant (UTC, Z).
context is an object.
Every context key is present (a descriptive one may be null).
A context key outside the nine (locale belongs to /v1/profile/sync).
platform is ios or android.
platform differs from the binding's (an ios binding).
device_class is phone or tablet.
A strict context value is never null.
os_version is a ver (1..32 printable characters).
app_version is a ver (at most 32 characters).
distribution is appstore, testflight, play, direct or debug.
events holds 1..200 events.

201 events: a batch holds at most 200.
